name: Arsia Mons skylights
coordinate_note: Per-site numbers were collected by Hermes with source URLs and not independently re-checked by Claude. status=sourced means a URL exists; unverified means no published number was found (leave empty, do not estimate); weak_source means the only source is Wikipedia and should be replaced. Site coordinates are approximate and from memory: verify against the USGS Mars gazetteer before use.

verified.detail: Cushing+ 2007 GRL 34 L17201: seven candidates, 100-225 m diameter, minimum depths 68-130 m.
Same paper: candidates 'too small and too high in elevation (>5.7 km)' for current landing technology; table lists 5,700 m (Chloe) to 15,500 m (Wendy).

facts.unit: m (MOLA datum, maximum within 150 km, computed from the 463 m DEM)
facts.note: sources conflict (11.7 km vs about 17.7 km)

verified.detail: Wikipedia lists 11.7 km (and elsewhere 'almost 20 km'); MOLA DEM max within 150 km of the Arsia point is 17,763 m (~17.8 km), so the 11.7 km figure is not height above the datum.
